load_model: load a trained SDFMap model from a checkpoint file using a ground truth mesh and device
load_res: load and return the JSON results file from an experiment directory
load_gt_sdf: load a ground truth signed distance field grid and create an interpolator from directory files
get_gpuf_sdf_interp: get a signed distance field interpolator from GpuFusion experiment output at a given evaluation time
get_voxblox_sdf_interp: get a signed distance field interpolator from VoxBloX experiment output using a ground truth mesh
